request: what's the difference between a linear and a nonlinear transformation of the grid

beats.intent: A square grid with one vector on it
beats.narration: Start with the ordinary grid and a single vector.
beats.code:
stage.title("Linear or not?")
p = draw_plane(stage)
v = draw_vector(stage, p, (1, 1), label="v")
stage.pause(1)

beats.intent: The grid tilted and stretched by a matrix, its lines still straight
beats.narration: A linear map moves the whole grid, but every line stays straight, parallel and evenly spaced.
beats.code:
apply_matrix(stage, p, [[1, 0.5], [-0.5, 1]], riders=[v])
stage.caption("Straight, parallel, evenly spaced; origin fixed")
stage.pause(1)

beats.intent: A fresh grid bent into wavy curves by a nonlinear map
beats.narration: Now push each point by a sine of its position: the grid lines bend into curves.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
p2 = draw_plane(stage)
p2.prepare_for_nonlinear_transform()
stage.play(p2.animate.apply_function(lambda q: q + 0.45 * np.array([np.sin(q[1]), np.sin(q[0]), 0])), run_time=2.5)
stage.caption("Grid lines bend: this map is not linear")
stage.pause(1)

beats.intent: The bent grid beside the rule a linear map must obey
beats.narration: Linear means scaling and adding inputs scales and adds the outputs; the bent grid breaks that rule.
beats.code:
stage.equation(r"L(a\vec{v} + b\vec{w}) = aL(\vec{v}) + bL(\vec{w})", where="right")
pulse(stage, p2)
stage.pause(1)

request: which matrix swaps the x and y axes

beats.code:
stage.title("Swapping the axes")
p = draw_plane(stage, where="left")
i_hat = draw_vector(stage, p, (1, 0), color=GREEN)
j_hat = draw_vector(stage, p, (0, 1), color=RED)
v = draw_vector(stage, p, (3, 1), color=YELLOW)
stage.caption("i-hat green, j-hat red, v = (3, 1)")
stage.pause(1)

beats.intent: The plane flipping across the dashed line y = x
beats.narration: Flip the plane over the diagonal line y equals x: i-hat and j-hat trade places.
beats.code:
mirror = draw_line(stage, p.c2p(-3, -3), p.c2p(3, 3), color=GREY_B, dashed=True)
apply_matrix(stage, p, [[0, 1], [1, 0]], riders=[i_hat, j_hat, v])
stage.caption("Green now points up, red points right")
stage.pause(1)

beats.intent: The swap matrix and where it sends (3, 1)
beats.narration: The columns say where i-hat and j-hat land, so the matrix is zero one, one zero, and (3, 1) becomes (1, 3).

stage.pause(1)

beats.intent: Flipping again puts every vector back

stage.caption("Swap twice: back where you started")
stage.pause(1)
